categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Legal
categories.content: Legal industry handles subjective disputes that cannot be solved by smart contracts.

categories.name: On-chain Gaming
categories.content: On-chain games refer to games where all components, including game logic, assets, interactions, and characteristics, are stored directly on the blockchain.

categories.name: TokenFi Launchpad
categories.content: TokenFi Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: RPG
categories.content: Role-playing game (RPG) is a video game genre where players control a single or group of character in a fictional world. RPG games typically include elements of storytelling, character development, exploration, quests, and inventory management.

categories.name: Simulation Games
categories.content: Simulation game replicates real-world activities, offering players the opportunity to experience different skills or activities in a virtual environment.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Telegram Apps
categories.content: Applications built on the Telegram platform that integrate cryptocurrency or blockchain technology.

categories.name: NFT Lending/Borrowing
categories.content: Individuals can use their NFTs as collateral to secure loans, or lend out their NFTs to others in exchange for interest, creating liquidity without the need to sell the NFTs themselves.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: DN-404
categories.content: The "Divisible NFT" standard (DN-404) aims to be a hybrid of ERC20 and ERC721 that could act as an NFT with native fractionalization built in.

categories.name: Play To Earn
categories.content: Play to Earn games are built on the blockchain, giving players full control over their gaming accounts and related assets, which they can sell on exchanges or secondary marketplaces.

categories.name: Gaming Utility Token
categories.content: Gaming Utility Tokens provide holders with benefits such as making in-game purchases, accessing special content, participating in events, or earning rewards.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Breeding
categories.content: Breeding games involve players using blockchain technology to breed unique digital creatures or items, represented as NFTs, creating offspring with potentially enhanced value and rarity.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.
